label: procedural clause words
explanation: It fires across short spans of how-to or technical explanatory text, most reliably on prepositions, conjunctions, determiners, and action verbs, especially after to, and, commas, auxiliaries, or then. Activation grows toward the end of the sequence, making late firings stronger than early ones. It is silent at position 0 and weak on ordinary content words outside such procedural clauses.
